title: Sinus pressure louder today?
caption: Head pressure easing a bit today? The sky is quiet and steady, so there is some room to recoup, though some people may still feel stirred from recent days or from heat, storms, smoke, or pollen. Keep it gentle—use short movement breaks to loosen tight spots and stop before the peak.
snapshot: Quiet geomagnetic backdrop today. Solar wind is in a normal range. No recent flares or CMEs observed. Conditions lean stable overall.
affects: Some may notice pain, dizziness, or fatigue ease in pockets when signals are steady. Others may still feel stirred up due to personal lag or local weather and air quality. Focus can be a bit more reliable once the body starts to settle.
playbook:
- Keep activity gentle and stop before the peak
- Use short movement breaks to unstick tension
- Hydrate and salt to taste if heat is up locally
- Check local pressure, storms, and allergens
- Bank small rests instead of one long crash
